bambu.scope: Selected reference models, not an exhaustive or permanently current catalogue

models.notes: Open frame; manufacturer cautions against large/high-density conventional high-temperature-material parts because of warping and interlayer-strength risks.
Consult model specifications, material requirements and fitted nozzle/extruder before selecting engineering or abrasive filament.
Consult current product specifications and compatible Bambu Studio profiles.

bambu.workflow: Ask exact printer/nozzle/plate/filament and slicer version; use manufacturer profile; check printable region, brim, purge zones, supports and orientation. Do not send/start prints without explicit user authorization. Verify newer models through current official sources.

models.notes: Select exact model and revision and retrieve its official specs; family members differ.

prusa.design_notes: Prusa describes fit tolerance as dependent on geometry, orientation, calibration, settings and material. Its suggested initial moving-part clearance is at least 0.3 mm; prototype/calibrate rather than treating this as a guaranteed fit.
